# ShivSastra — Shivam Shukla

> ShivSastra is the personal engineering portfolio, studio, and digital product platform of Shivam Shukla, focused on backend systems, agentic AI workflows, and software security.

Shivam Shukla is an AI engineer and backend developer specializing in deterministic systems, agentic workflows, and defensive application architecture. The platform documents production-grade software engineering projects, technical case studies, practical consulting services, and curated developer resources.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://www.jiosi.online/): Overview of engineering focus areas across Backend Systems, Agentic AI, and AI Security.
- [About](https://www.jiosi.online/about): Background, technical philosophy, verified experience at Nexvia Technologies and Soft Pro, education, and credentials of Shivam Shukla.
- [Projects](https://www.jiosi.online/projects): Portfolio of client case studies, engineering builds, and open-source systems.
- [Services](https://www.jiosi.online/services): Professional web development and AI integration services, including website bug fixing, Next.js landing pages, API integrations, AI chatbots & workflow automation, and security reviews.
- [Contact](https://www.jiosi.online/contact): Direct contact channel for project inquiries, architecture reviews, and consulting engagements.
- [Resume](https://www.jiosi.online/resume): Verified curriculum vitae detailing software engineering background, technical stack, and education.

## Featured Projects

- [Yojna Setu](https://www.jiosi.online/projects/yojna-setu): AI + deterministic rules engine evaluated across 82 welfare schemes, decoupling natural-language intake from deterministic Java business logic.
- [ShivSastra Digital HQ](https://www.jiosi.online/projects/shivsastra): Full-stack platform built with Next.js App Router, Supabase PostgreSQL with Row-Level Security, Razorpay integration, and a sandboxed AI assistant.
- [RealGuard](https://www.jiosi.online/projects/realguard): AI automation and conversational real estate workflow connecting WhatsApp intake to RERA verification, deterministic EMI calculations, and CRM persistence.
- [QuickEats](https://www.jiosi.online/projects/quickeats): Real-time food ordering and delivery system engineered with Spring Boot 3, server-side price recalculation, IDOR defenses, and STOMP WebSockets.
